description:
Ground floor rear side infill extension with 3 no. velux windows.  Rear pod extension to the outrigger.  Increase
to the width of the rear dormer to the main roof.  Replace the existing windows to the front dormer extension
with 3 no. traditional sliding sash windows.  Replace the existing flat roof to the garage with a new hipped roof
to form a continuous roof with the proposed side infill extension.  Replace the doors to the garage with a new
set of timber doors.  Remove the front door and deadlight to the front entrance.  Install a new sliding window
and Juliet balcony to the rear-facing wall of the garage and convert the rear part of the garage to habitable use.
Clad the walls of the garage with a dark composite timber-effect cladding.
decision_conditions:
Fire Safety Strategy required

The London Plan 2021 - Policy D12 (A) and D5 and
https://www.london.gov.uk/sites/default/files/draft_guidance_sheet_d5_b5_evacuation_lifts_070720_web.pdf (london.gov.uk)

London Plan policy D12 requires the submission of a Fire Safety Strategy on all planning applications. The Fire Safety Strategy should be presented as a standalone document with a clear structure that addresses the criteria set out in London Plan Policy D12 part A.  The submitted drawings should address the requirements set out at paragraphs 3.12.3 and 3.12.4 of the London Plan. Where the applicant considers parts of or the whole policy do not apply, this should be justified in a Reasonable Exception Statement (RES).  Draft guidance on Fire Safety Strategies is available at:
https://www.london.gov.uk/what-we-do/planning/implementing-london-plan/london-plan-guidance/fire-safety-guidance-pre-consultation-information

Where the proposal includes a lift, the applicant should address the requirements of London Plan policy D5 within their Fire Safety Statement.
